subject: Final-mile play: MSA / DPA / Order Form sequencing and tight timeline
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aurelia Therapeutics <procurement@aurelia-thera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final-mile play: MSA / DPA / Order Form sequencing and tight timeline

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our conversation I sketched a compact close plan that aligns the MSA signature, DPA review, and Order Form acceptance so you can hit your internal launch target the week of Sep 13. The attached "Aurelia_Final-MAP_v3.xlsx" is a concise mutual-action checklist with owners and deadlines. High level: 

- Week 1 (this week): procurement and legal intake 
- Week 2: vendor legal redline + DPA review in parallel (our legal will prioritize)
- Week 3: final MSA sign + order form execution + provisioning kickoff

Two asks from your side to make this realistic: 
1) Confirm the procurement intake packet owners and target sign-off date on your side (we put Sep 10 as a hard date).
2) Let us know if there are any non-standard clauses that require product changes or a security exception — we can surface to engineering but need that by Sep 2.

Karthik (cc) is leading legal sequencing on our side and can propose a trimmed review cadence if Aurelia is comfortable with our standard DPA. Marissa will manage the execution and milestone check-ins.

Attaching the MAP and a proposed DocuSign path (we can break the Order Form into a separate envelope if Aurelia prefers).

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment: Aurelia_Final-MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Elena Moretti <elena.moretti@aurelia-thera.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurelia-thera.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 15:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Final-mile play: MSA / DPA / Order Form sequencing and tight timeline

Laura —

Appreciate the concise plan and attachments. We like the compact approach; a couple notes from procurement/legal intake: 

- Our internal procurement deadline is Sep 9 (we can target final approval Sep 10 with an exec sign-off window Sep 11-12).
- Legal flagged two items: (1) a liability cap point in section 9.4 of the MSA, and (2) data localization language in the DPA (we operate in mixed EU/US workflows).

I attached our internal procurement timeline for reference. Can you confirm whether Redwood is willing to accept a capped liability at $2M and to confirm that the DPA offers EU processing assurances? If not, we will escalate to our CISO/legal and that will add 5–7 business days.

Happy to do a quick 20-min call Tue afternoon if that helps speed decisions.

Thanks,
Elena Moretti
Head of Procurement | Aurelia Therapeutics
elena.moretti@aurelia-thera.com

Attachment: Aurelia_Procurement_Timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Final-mile play: MSA / DPA / Order Form sequencing and tight timeline

Marissa / Karthik —

Forwarding Aurelia's response. Two quick things: 
1) They want a $2M liability cap — that is below our default tiers but might be acceptable for a pilot with clear acceptance windows.
2) DPA localization ask (EU processing assurances) — product will need clarity on where data is processed and whether we can commit to EU subprocessors / SCCs for the pilot.

Goal: keep to the Sep 10 sign target. Proposed internal approach: Karthik triages the legal asks and we offer a 2-step signature: (a) Order Form + MSA (with liability note) and (b) DPA to follow with SCCs attached as an exhibit. If Aurelia insists on DPA before Order Form, we need to escalate their CISO and expect +5 business days.

Can you both review and flag any non-starters by EOD? Also, Karthik — can you draft a slim exception path we can propose (e.g., temporary SCC supplement + conditional liability tier tied to pilot scope)?

Thanks,
Laura

---Original message attached above---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Final-mile play: MSA / DPA / Order Form sequencing and tight timeline

Laura / Marissa —

Thanks for the context. High-level legal guidance and a proposed sequencing script below. Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Exception_Matrix.pdf (summary).

Quick read: we can accommodate a $2M cap for a 6-month pilot if Aurelia accepts a limited SLA credit and provides a mutual hold-harmless carve-out for third-party integrations. Alternative: keep our standard liability and shorten the pilot to a feature-limited scope. 

DPA / localization: we have SCCs and an EU subprocessors addendum we can provide immediately. If Aurelia's CISO requires in-region processing, that is an engineering scheduling question; otherwise SCCs + technical appendix suffice for most customers and do not block signature.

Proposed sequencing script to propose to Aurelia: 
- Day 0: Execute Order Form & MSA (MSA includes liability cap at $2M for pilot term)
- Day 1–3: Send DPA + SCC exhibit in parallel for countersign — provide a 48-72 hour expedited review window
- Day 4–7: Should countersign occur, provisioning and entitlement enablement; otherwise automatic fallback: Order Form remains in force but onboarding gated until DPA countersign.

Action items (internal): 
- Karthik: prepare redline of the MSA liability section with conditional pilot language (ETA EOD 1 Sep).
- Marissa: confirm internal provisioning lead and whether we can stagger infra allocation in case countersign slips (low risk).

I'll attach the DPA matrix and a templated SCC exhibit we can push to them via Drive link. 

Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Exception_Matrix.pdf (pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aurelia Therapeutics <procurement@aurelia-thera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile play: MSA / DPA / Order Form sequencing and tight timeline

Elena / Samir —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing your timeline. Based on Karthik's guidance we propose the following compact path so you can keep the Sep 13 launch target: 

1) Today: execute the attached MSA + Order Form (we will accept the $2M pilot liability cap as a one-time concession; language in section 9.4 will explicitly state the cap applies to the pilot term only).
2) Within 72 hours: Redwood issues the DPA + SCC exhibit for countersign (we request expedited review).
3) If DPA countersign completes within 5 business days, provisioning / onboarding proceeds as planned. If not, the Order Form remains valid but onboarding will be paused until data processing terms are agreed.

We attached an updated MAP (Aurelia_Final-MAP_v3.xlsx) showing owners and dates aligned to the path above and included a DocuSign envelope link for the MSA/Order Form (link below). Please confirm that procurement can sign by EOD Sep 3 to hit the timeline.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/AURE-042-ds
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAPProposal
HubSpot: HS-498221

If you prefer a call, Marissa can host a 15-min run-through of the MAP and sign sequence this afternoon.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
